dump_file.description: The file path where sipdump writes captured SIP digest authentications and where sipcrack reads them from.

wordlist_file.description: The path to the file containing all passwords to try for bruteforcing.

verbose_interval.description: Print cracking process progress every n passwords. High values improve performance; low values provide feedback but slow down execution.

use_stdin.description: If true, sipcrack reads passwords from standard input instead of the wordlist file.
